recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-51843 unless a future ballot asks to refine Transport.period semantics beyond the accepted R6 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-51843 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking to replace Transport.completionTime, a 0..1 dateTime completion timestamp, with Transport.period, a 0..1 Period carrying transport start and end timing, including the accepted short display, definition, summary flag, and comment for ongoing transports.
initial_application: The requested change was already applied before this reconciliation. Commit da0a7cd20877cb3935d7e19a9f9acf7c870743cb replaced Transport.completionTime with Transport.period in source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml and updated the Event.occurrence[x] mapping exception; commit 3c3e1928ce9d6891448313963cd7c1c8c6471871 added period to the Transport example. Earlier commit 9ca054b3f79cbb741e241664b76d3a55baf40439 for FHIR-36275 explains the prior completionTime baseline.
additional_context: Transport is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO with FMM 2, so the inspected Transport StructureDefinition and example sources are current build inputs. OO Confluence minutes on 2025-08-18 record the need to update transport.completionTime to transport.period using the Event occurrence pattern, and the 2025-08-25 OO Specimen minutes record the exact replacement with a 4-0-0 Persuasive vote. Later FHIR-51849 cleanup touched the same Transport source area and example references without changing Transport.period. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml already defines Transport.period as 0..1 Period with the requested metadata and comment, source/transport/transport-event-mapping-exceptions.xml maps it to Event.occurrence[x], source/transport/transport-example.xml uses period, and a source-wide grep found no completionTime references.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Transport work introduced the completionTime element that FHIR-51843 later replaced.
Subsequent Transport cleanup touched the same resource/example after FHIR-51843 without changing Transport.period.
